text: When we use hand gestures, we're not just moving our hands, we're creating a visual anchor that grabs the audience's attention. text: Structural gestures help us navigate the presentation, connecting ideas and easing transitions. For example, if I'm saying first, second, third, I can use a gesture to emphasize each point. It helps the audience follow along and understand the flow of the presentation.

speaker: speaker-1
text: Content gestures serve to visually illustrate elements within the text. Let's say I'm talking about a circle; I can use a circular gesture to help the audience visualize it. It's about bringing the story to life with our hands.
